Devdutt Padikkal Sets Records in Sri Lanka Test Innings

Cricketer Devdutt Padikkal has achieved significant milestones in a Test match in Sri Lanka, scoring 167 runs and breaking a 58-year-old record. He has entered the top 5 Indian batters for the highest innings in Sri Lanka Tests, with Sachin Tendulkar also featuring in the top 5. Padikkal expressed his joy, stating he had dreamed of such a moment.
